documentation.title: Removed Terminating Case With Semicolon
documentation.standard: Terminating a switch `case`/`default` condition statement with a semicolon, instead of a colon, is deprecated since PHP 8.5.

code.title: Cross-version compatible: terminating a case/default statement with a colon.
